placements.role: Supplies Ethernet and InfiniBand switches and interconnect for accelerated AI clusters.

role_evidence.claim: Dell'Oro's June 2026 release ranks NVIDIA among the leading vendors of switches deployed in AI back-end networks.

placements.role: Designs and sells GPUs and purpose-built accelerators for AI training and inference.

role_evidence.claim: Current AI-chip research identifies NVIDIA GPUs as the market-leading accelerators for AI training.

placements.role: Trains and releases the Nemotron family of frontier-scale foundation and reasoning models.

role_evidence.claim: NVIDIA's official model page identifies Nemotron 3 Ultra as a frontier-scale general-purpose reasoning model trained by NVIDIA.

business_summary: NVIDIA Corporation designs the GPUs and purpose-built accelerators that train and serve most large AI models, and increasingly ships the Ethernet (Spectrum-X) and InfiniBand (Quantum) switches and NVLink interconnect that stitch those GPUs into single AI clusters. It also trains and releases the open Nemotron family of reasoning models. It sits on three links of this chain: networking-optics, ai-accelerators (its core business), and frontier-models.

exposure_summary.narrative: NVIDIA's networking-optics placement is a real but secondary business line next to its accelerator franchise: Dell'Oro's June 2026 AI back-end networking release ranks it among the leading switch vendors, evidence that is dated and cited but does not carry a revenue split. The ai-accelerators placement is the company's dominant business by a wide margin, which means an un-crowded thesis on the networking link specifically is hard to isolate: the market already prices NVIDIA overwhelmingly on GPU demand.

disclosed_revenue_exposure.basis: No revenue-exposure percentage for this chain's links is disclosed in the sources on file: the mapping role_evidence for NVIDIA carries qualitative product/operator claims, not a segment revenue split, and no data/edgar/docs/NVDA.json filing is on disk this run to check for one.

latest_fy.basis: data/market/NVDA.json fundamentals.revenue_fy's latest entry is 2022-01-30, while net_income_fy/operating_income_fy/operating_cashflow_fy report as recently as 2026-01-25; the revenue series has stopped updating and reporting the stale figure as latest_fy would misstate current scale.

revenue_cagr_3y.basis: data/market/NVDA.json fundamentals.revenue_fy does not carry a clean three-fiscal-year-prior data point matched to the latest entry; revenue CAGR cannot be computed without inventing an intermediate figure.

operating_margin.basis: data/market/NVDA.json fundamentals.revenue_fy (latest 2022-01-30) and operating_income_fy (latest 2026-01-25) do not share a common latest fiscal-year date, so operating margin cannot be computed without mixing periods.

operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/NVDA.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.basis: Net cash provided by operating activities 102718000000 divided by net income 120067000000 for the fiscal year ended 2026-01-25, both from companyfacts.

net_debt_to_ebitda.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/NVDA.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
net_debt_to_ebitda.basis: Net debt 9923000000 (total debt 32366000000 as of 2026-07-26 less cash 22443000000 as of 2026-07-26) divided by an EBITDA proxy 133230000000 (operating income 130387000000 plus depreciation 2843000000 for the fiscal year ended 2026-01-25).

piotroski.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/NVDA.json quality, computed in the Actions venue over SEC EDGAR companyfacts with financetoolkit.models
piotroski.basis: Piotroski F-score 4 (state MIDDLING) computed over SEC companyfacts statements in data/market/NVDA.json quality.piotroski.

beneish_state.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/NVDA.json quality, computed in the Actions venue over SEC EDGAR companyfacts with financetoolkit.models
beneish_state.basis: Beneish M-score -1.645, earnings-manipulation state REVIEW, computed over SEC companyfacts statements in data/market/NVDA.json quality.beneish. A more negative M-score is the non-manipulator reading.

market_cap.basis: Market capitalization 5287335200000.0 = SEC companyfacts diluted share count 24304000000 (as of 2026-01-25) multiplied by the close 217.55 of 2026-08-28 from the repo's own market plane (data/market/NVDA.json), not an issuer document.

price_to_earnings.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/NVDA.json quality.derived.market_cap over SEC companyfacts net income
price_to_earnings.basis: Market capitalization 5287335200000.0 divided by fiscal year 2026-01-25 GAAP net income 120067000000.

implied_fcf_cagr.basis: Free-cash-flow CAGR the current enterprise value 5297258200000.0 implies over a 5-year explicit period on base FCF 102579265000.0, solved by bisection on FCF CAGR at a 0.09 discount rate and 0.025 terminal growth. The discount rate and terminal growth are assumed, so the solve is an assumption-dependent expectation reading, not a reported figure.

horizon_spread.basis: Spread between the implied CAGR solved over the shortest and longest explicit periods in quality.reverse_dcf.implied_by_horizon ({'5': 0.3275, '7': 0.2424, '10': 0.1824}). It measures how much of the expectation reading is a horizon convention rather than a statement about price, and inherits the same assumed discount rate and terminal growth.

crowdedness_caveats: ai-accelerators is chain-heat OVER_CROWDED and networking-optics is CROWDED; NVIDIA is the single most-covered name in this entire chain, sell-side and retail alike.

The revenue_fy series in data/market/NVDA.json's SEC companyfacts pull stops at fiscal year 2022 while net income, operating income and operating cash flow report current 2026 figures; three canonical fields (latest_fy revenue, 3-year revenue CAGR, operating margin) are NULL here rather than built on that stale number, which is itself worth flagging for a fetch-pipeline fix.

catalysts.claim: NVIDIA is named as a leading vendor of switches deployed in AI back-end networks in Dell'Oro's mid-2026 tracking, evidence the networking placement is real and growing alongside GPU attach rates, not a nominal listing.
Net debt to EBITDA computed from current SEC companyfacts data is 0.07x, and operating cash flow covers 86% of net income; the balance sheet and cash generation are not the constraint on this name.
catalysts.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/NVDA.json

risks.claim: Piotroski F-score is 4 (MIDDLING) and the Beneish M-score of -1.645 sits inside the REVIEW band above the -1.78 threshold; the fundamentals quality read is not clean at this scale of profitability.
The reverse DCF solved on current enterprise value implies a 32.75% five-year free-cash-flow CAGR; that is the bar the market has already set, and it is a high one to keep clearing.

Revenue, revenue growth and operating margin are all NULL in this profile because data/market/NVDA.json's revenue_fy series has not updated past fiscal 2022; any external view of NVIDIA's actual current growth needs a source outside this store's revenue series.

data_gaps: revenue.latest_fy, growth.revenue_cagr_3y and margins.operating_margin are NULL: the market store's revenue_fy series stalled at fiscal year 2022 while net income, operating income and operating cash flow report through fiscal 2026, so no consistent-period revenue figure exists in this store to report as current.
valuation carries only price_to_earnings; price_to_sales and ev_to_sales are withheld for the same stale-revenue reason rather than computed against a 2022 denominator.
No data/edgar/docs/NVDA.json filing is on disk this run, so no verbatim earnings quote backs the business summary beyond the mapping's own dated role evidence.

disposition.basis: Newly profiled to close the networking-optics link's zero-coverage gap. Retained at O2 pending selection: three canonical metrics are NULL for a real data-pipeline reason (stale revenue series), not absence of research, and the name is already the most heavily covered issuer in the chain, which argues against an un-crowded thesis on this link specifically.

confidence_audit.basis: Counts cover the canonical metric fields only. VERIFIED is a figure read directly off SEC companyfacts as reported. INFERRED is a figure computed from SEC companyfacts, with the derivation named in its basis. SPECULATIVE is reserved for the reverse-DCF solve, whose discount rate and terminal growth are assumed. NULL is a field looked for and not found or unusable without mixing reporting periods, never estimated.

notes: Profiles are medium-depth reusable research. This file carries no final verdict, no entry zone and no red team; those belong to the deep-dive stage.
Data tier (T1/T2/T3) describes data availability. Opportunity tier (O1/O2/O3) describes research priority. Neither implies the other.
